tasks.title: Product direction: overview-first analyzer with a built-in Power Platform add-on
tasks.brief: Structra is a fully local JSON analyzer for everyone. The Power Platform tools (expressions, Parse JSON schema, Power Fx, flow actions) ship built in as an always-visible add-on for makers using canvas apps and cloud flows. Main job: understand an unknown payload in under a minute. Look: calm workbench.

subtasks.title: Overview replaces Stats and opens first after load (files up to 25 MB; bigger files open on the tree): plain-language headline, key figures, 'worth a look' findings with one-click jumps, biggest lists grouped by pattern, then the existing detail tables. Logic in core/insights.js

Guided first run: welcome dialog, paste anywhere with Ctrl+V on an empty tab, a 'try a sample' link under the drop area, and a one-time tip after the first document about the Power Platform expressions
First-run welcome dialog (shown once, reopen from the command palette as 'Welcome'): purpose, privacy, Power Platform add-on, light/dark choice, Try a sample / Open a file / Skip

Power Platform add-on prominent: the rail's Power Platform button opens the Expressions tab (it did nothing before), the Overview flags connector-shaped payloads, the Transform and Settings rail buttons now work too, and the rail highlight follows what is open

Power Automate expressions: source selector (action output, trigger body, loop item, custom), null-safe ?['k'] and ?[0], whole-action-output detection; checked against Microsoft docs, unit tested and verified in the browser
Parse JSON schema: nullable keys as type lists, nested objects and lists merged across rows, 'number' by default with an integer option, required toggle; unit tested
Power Fx: each column converted by its real type (Value, Boolean, DateValue, DateTimeValue, Text), quoted names, editable variable; unit tested
Flow actions tab: Select, Filter array, Apply to each, Compose and Condition as copyable action JSON; unit tested and verified in the browser
Committed fixture smoke test: npm run test:smoke (PW_CHANNEL=msedge to use the installed Edge); 30 fixtures x 6 views, fails on any page error or missing Overview headline

Node unit tests: npm test runs 47 tests (engine analysis, schema generation, expressions and paths, insights). The test runner now waits for async tests; before that an async failure could have printed ok

Large files, measured with tests/perf/large.js (Edge): the 37 MB file shows the Overview in 0.5 s (worst freeze 0.15 s) and the 88 MB file in 2.0 s (worst freeze 0.67 s, 210 MB heap). Overview now opens first up to 120 MB. Not built: a cancel button, and a worker for parsing (the earlier test found copying the data to a worker cost more than parsing it)

Engine duplicates removed: one _tableOf(ds) instead of 14 copies, CSV export reuses Structra.convert.generateCsv (it also handles nested values correctly). Fixed a bug found on the way: SQL find results broke the tree filter because it expected a Set but got a list. The JavaScript and DuckDB paths themselves stay: DuckDB is optional and loads on demand, so the JavaScript path is the fallback by design

Dialogs on the shared overlay base: shortcuts, typedef, diff, null finder, pivot, snippets and workspace now use StructraOverlay (open, close, Escape, backdrop, focus trap come from one place); about 35 old overlay, panel and header CSS rules removed. The smoke test opens and closes ten dialogs

tasks.title: One icon system (Lucide, ISC licence, bundled locally)
tasks.brief: About 70 inline SVGs were hand-copied across components (the close X alone appeared 9 times) plus glyph icons. Now every icon comes from the Lucide library (ISC licence) through one small wrapper, Structra.icons. The library loads from the jsDelivr CDN with a bundled copy as the offline fallback; only icon artwork is fetched, data processing stays local.

subtasks.title: Pick the library: Lucide (ISC, stroke icons that match the current Feather-style set, 1,500+ icons, per-icon SVG files)

API: svg(name, {size, cls, color, stroke}), has(name), hydrate(root) for <i data-icon> placeholders; color accepts theme token names so icons follow every theme
Replace inline SVGs in all components, header, rail, canvas header, overlays, index.html
Command palette: icon names instead of raw path strings
Replace glyph and emoji icons (play, check, times, swap arrows, status marks) with icons

Check every screen in dark and light; run the 30-fixture smoke test

After Apply in the Editor the tab keeps the name 'sample-data.json' with no 'edited' dot, so a maker cannot tell the file no longer matches what was opened; there is no Revert to original or Save as file

Editor Repair works well (single quotes, trailing comma, comment, True) but the repair message for hopeless input is jargon ('Unexpected end of json string at position 1'); also no diff of what was repaired

Toolbar 'Edit' just switches to the Editor tab, which is already in the view tabs; two entries for one place, and 'Copy' at the far right is not explained (copies what: whole document, selection, or path?)

Minimap: floating box at the top right overlaps the Editor's 'Valid JSON' status (only 'ON' shows), has no border contrast or close button, uses unlabelled coloured blocks, and is offered in views (Editor, Overview) where it means nothing; there is no legend and no tooltip

Command palette lists every command in every state: Undo/Redo, Zoom to Fit, Expand All appear on an empty tab or in the Editor; unavailable commands should be hidden or dimmed with a reason. There is no Power Platform command (Expressions, Schema Gen, Choose columns, Copy Power Automate expression)

Size Heatmap: only a floating legend 'Heatmap ON Small Medium Large' appears (about 300 px from the right edge, not aligned to anything) and no row in the Tree is coloured; it does not say what 'size' means (bytes? child count?) and the toggle state is not visible anywhere else

Shortcuts listed in the palette do not all work: Ctrl+D (Diff) did nothing in the browser; the shortcut list needs a check against real key handling and against browser-reserved keys (Ctrl+D is Bookmark in most browsers)

Diff dialog works, but the summary '+1 -0 ~2' is unlabelled (added, removed, changed), the paste box disappears after Compare so the right side cannot be corrected, and the Right dropdown still reads 'Paste JSON...'

Graph: clicking a node gives no feedback (no selected state, the path bar stays 'Click an element...', no side panel) and a click on a parent does not collapse its children; nodes cannot be expanded or collapsed from the graph
Graph: a small graph sits in the top left corner of a large empty canvas; it should open centred and fit to the view; the zoom bar floats at the bottom left and is not aligned with the canvas edge

Pivot dialog: the drop zones are empty boxes with no hint until a field is clicked, chips look draggable but only click works, 'Generate Pivot' on a field with no rows shows 'No results' without saying why (the file has no list of records), and the Count/Sum selector floats under Values without a label

Accessibility: the document tabs and the bottom tabs have no accessible names or roles (file tab is a plain generic), line numbers are read as text '1 2 3 4 5 4 5 6', toolbar icon buttons like +All and -All have no labels, and the Graph nodes expose no role; keyboard-only use of rail, tabs and dialogs needs a pass

Type Definitions: for a pasted CSV where qty and price are empty in some rows, TypeScript says 'qty: number; price: number;' (should be number | null or optional); same for the other languages. The Overview already flagged both as 33% null, so the two views disagree

Type Definitions: 'Root name: Root' produces 'RootItem' in TypeScript and 'RootType' in Power Fx, so the name box does not match the output; the code box is short and scrolls inside a dialog that has free space; Power Fx sits between languages instead of under the Power Platform add-on
Wording is inconsistent across entry points: 'Try a sample', 'try a sample', 'Load Sample', 'Load & Explore', 'Open a file or a recent one'; pick one verb per action

Workspace export saves only the active tab's data (995 B file with one 'data' list), not the other open tabs, the current view, expressions source, chosen columns or loop name; it is the only way to keep a session and it cannot restore one. The dialog stays open after export and gives no hint where the file went

Workspace import replaces the active tab's data with no confirmation and no summary of what was restored (tabs, bookmarks, snippets); the toast 'Workspace imported successfully' is all the feedback, and the file picker is the unstyled browser 'Choose File' control with a separate Import button

Export View as Image fails with the toast 'Image export failed: Attempting to parse an unsupported color function "color"': the image library cannot read the CSS color-mix and color() tokens used by the V2 themes, so the feature is broken in every view

Convert to XML writes invalid XML: null values become <qty xsi:nil="true"/> but the xsi namespace is never declared on <root>, so any parser fails with 'unbound prefix' (confirmed with a CSV of 3 rows). Convert to YAML output is correct. Both exports use fixed names (export.yaml, export.xml) instead of the document name

Find Duplicate Keys on a pasted CSV (and on any data that was parsed, repaired, edited or loaded from a recent entry) only toasts 'The original text of this document is not available' instead of saying 'No duplicate keys' or running on the data; the message is jargon and the check has no result view

Mask Sensitive Data (Ctrl+Shift+P) says 'Masked 4 sensitive values' for a list with 2 emails and 2 phone numbers but the Tree and Table still show the real values; a maker who trusts the toast would share unmasked data. Same root cause as the sort and flatten tools (item about tools not updating state); this one is a privacy risk so it should be treated as critical
The Paste Data box keeps the text pasted into the previous tab (the old CSV was still there in a new tab) and the Format dropdown keeps its previous choice; a new tab should start empty

Palette 'Run SQL Query' does not open any SQL editor: the first time nothing happens at all (SQL stays 'SQL off'), the second time it switches the view to Overview and opens the Query & Filter panel on the Transform tab. There is no place to type SQL anywhere; the only way to turn SQL on is clicking the small 'SQL off' chip in the status bar, which has no tooltip and turns into a green 'SQL' check without saying what is now possible
Rail shows two buttons as active at once (Query & Filter and Overview) after a palette command; the active rail state should follow the one open panel
Ctrl+K failed to open the palette right after clicking the status bar SQL chip (focus left in the chip); global shortcuts should work wherever the focus is, except inside text boxes

Fuzzy Search (DuckDB) asks for its term in a native browser prompt() box (unthemed, blocks the page) and then shows only the toast 'Fuzzy: undefined matches' with no results list and no highlighting, even with SQL on; the term 'anne' against 'Ann' should have matched

Column Distribution (DuckDB) reports only the first numeric column as a toast ('id: median=1.5, stddev=0.71') that disappears in seconds; there is no table of all columns with count, min, max, median, spread and no way to keep the result

Overview for a file that is just 'true' (edge_bool.json) says 'A single value.' but Type distribution shows '1 Objects' and the bottom chip says '1 obj'; a boolean must be counted as a boolean. Check the same for a top level null, number and string

Load URL: the request panel is a small REST client (method, Auth, Headers, Body) shown to every maker with no explanation, and it does not say that the browser blocks pages that do not allow cross origin requests (CORS); the loaded file keeps the URL's file name as the tab name, which is good, but the URL is not remembered in Recent with its headers

Load URL for a file that contains only 'null' shows '200 OK, 68ms, 4 B' and then stays on the loader: nothing opens, no message says the document is a null value; top level null is valid JSON and should open as a single null value

Document tabs cannot be reordered by dragging, have no right-click menu (Close others, Close to the right, Duplicate, Rename), and every 'Load from URL', 'New tab' or palette load adds another 'Untitled N' tab instead of reusing an empty one; five tabs already crowd the strip with no overflow control

Dark theme looks consistent in Table, Tree and the side panel (distinct panels, readable table, accent on tabs); but the side panel and canvas are only about 2 percent apart in lightness, so the panel edge is hard to see without the 1px border; check the High Contrast and custom themes

High Contrast theme: app background is #000000 and panels are #0a0a0a, so the side panel, Table and canvas merge into one black area separated only by a faint grey line; a high contrast theme needs bright borders (the Borders token is #7a7a7a) and the disabled pager buttons are almost invisible

Custom theme editor is good (live preview, contrast badges with AA), but it opens scrolled to the bottom of the dialog with the theme list half off screen, has two confirm buttons (Save theme and Done) and the Cancel button is easy to confuse with other dialogs; the Mode hint 'System follows your operating system' stays the same for Light, Dark and System

Closed dialogs stay in the page as hidden copies (Snippet Library, Welcome, Input overlay duplicate Cancel, Light, Send, Paste Data and the sample link controls), so keyboard focus order and screen readers can reach duplicates; dialogs and the input overlay should be created on open and removed on close

Generate Mock Data says 'Mock data generated from structure' but opens no tab and shows no result; the clipboard did not receive mock JSON when read back, so the maker has nothing to use. It should open the mock in a new tab (or a preview with Copy and Download) and say how many rows were made

Recent list works and opens into the empty tab, but it stores the full text of every file in the browser (the Pasted JSON entry shows emails and phone numbers in its preview), has only a 'Clear History' button and no per-entry remove, lists the same name twice (two 'Pasted JSON' tabs after reopening) and the long list scrolls the whole card instead of an inner list

CORRECTION to the Mock Data item: Generate Mock Data does replace the open document, but only after a delay and only in the Table (the Table later showed 3 mock rows such as 43751 / magna@example.com in place of the 2 real rows), with no confirmation, no new tab and no Undo; the tab name 'Pasted JSON' and the Tree and Overview state do not say the data was replaced. Mock must open in a new tab and never overwrite the user's file

Table column Hide and restore work well (the '1 hidden' chip brings the column back); the column menu mixes arrow glyphs and emoji icons (triangles, arrow, circle, chart emoji), which looks unfinished next to the Lucide icons in the rest of the app

Schema view reads types from the first record only: Requester.Department and JobTitle show 'null' although rows 2 and 3 hold 'HR' and 'Facilities' (should be 'string, nullable'), Picture shows 'string' although row 2 is null; 'required' appears only on the top two keys and never on item fields, so the Schema view contradicts the Schema Gen tab that already handles nullable and required

Table 'Distinct Values' still fails with SQL on: console 'Catalog Error: Table with name data does not exist' while the user sees only a stale toast; same for Column Stats (see earlier item), so both stay silent failures

Schema view rows are not clickable: clicking 'Email' does nothing and the Expressions tab keeps saying 'Select a path in the tree' although the user is in the Schema view; the Schema view is where a maker sees the field list, so a click should select the field and show its expressions

Typing a path in the path bar and pressing Enter updates the breadcrumb and the Expressions tab but does not scroll the Tree to that node or highlight it (the Tree stayed at line 1 while the target Email is at line 18 of the first item and line 45 of the second), and the autocomplete suggestion list stays open over the document tabs

Expressions tab with the drawer at its default height shows only about two and a half rows (the third row 'Access value' is cut in half); the rows are the useful part, so the drawer should show at least 5 rows or open taller when a value is selected

Canvas app expressions tab has no row for use inside a gallery or ForAll (ThisItem.Requester.Email or ThisRecord.Requester.Email) for a value inside a list item; the first rows only offer Index(ParseJSON(jsonText).value, 2).Requester.Email, so the maker must rewrite it by hand (the loop-relative rows exist only for Power Automate, and the Node panel quick set is not wired in)

At 820 x 700 the layout is cramped: the left panel keeps 300 px so the Tree gets about 470 px and only 140 px of height (the bottom drawer takes the rest); the view toolbar is cut off after '+All' so D1 to D3, Find, Filter, Wrap, Edit and Copy cannot be reached and there is no overflow menu; the Expressions sub tabs wrap onto two lines ('Power Automate', 'Flow actions') and expression text breaks in the middle of words (Index(ParseJSON(jsonTe / xt)...)); tabs end in a clipped 'Pasted JS'

CRITICAL, Find blanks the Tree again: on the SharePoint sample (opened from Recent, with a path selected and the drawer open) searching 'Laptop' or 'contoso' shows '1 found' and an empty Tree, even after scrolling to the top; pressing Clear brings the document back. The earlier blank-tree fix (99b0b57) does not cover this case, so find the real cause and add a smoke test that runs Find on every fixture and checks that matching rows are rendered

Find counts look wrong: 'contoso' appears in 6 strings of the sample but the bar says '1 found'; and the case-sensitive 'Aa' toggle is on by default so a maker typing 'laptop' finds nothing. The three mode buttons are tiny symbols (Aa, ~, .*) with only a hover title, the replace pencil has no label, and the box floats over the top right of the Tree and its scrollbar

Helpers tab, 'Apply to each' block: the nested list Tags uses items('Apply_to_each')?['Id'] for its own fields, the same loop name as the outer loop; the inner loop over items('Apply_to_each')?['Tags'] should be named Apply_to_each_2 and read items('Apply_to_each_2')?['Value']; the first row for the Tags list itself is body('Parse_JSON')?['value']?[0]?['Tags'] (a fixed index) instead of items('Apply_to_each')?['Tags']

Helpers tab 'Compose and variables' rows give body('Parse_JSON')?['keyName'] and ?['arrayName'] as examples; these are placeholder names that do not exist in the data, so a maker copying them gets null. Use the first real key of the data or hide the rows

Flow actions tab for a single scalar value offers only 'Compose: this value' with a fixed index (value?[1]); for a value inside a list item it should also offer Condition on this field, Set variable and an Apply to each that reads the same field

Keyboard Shortcuts dialog shows 'Alt + –' for both Back and Forward (a dash instead of the left and right arrow keys), so the two rows look identical; it also omits Ctrl+= / Ctrl+- / Ctrl+0 (zoom), Alt+Left and Alt+Right as written in the palette, and '?' itself, and the dialog has no search

Back and Forward buttons next to the path bar work (history of selected paths) but only change the breadcrumb and Expressions: the Tree does not move to the node, so the buttons look dead for a maker who only watches the document

Alt+W (and the tab x button) closes a tab at once with no confirmation even when the tab holds edited, masked or mocked data, and there is no 'Reopen closed tab' (Ctrl+Shift+T) or Undo toast; after closing, the path bar falls back to '$' without telling which tab is now shown

Schema Gen works well and matches Power Automate Parse JSON needs (nullable types as lists, required keys, items for arrays, copy toast), so it should be the single source for the Schema view and the Type Definitions dialog, which both disagree with it

Tree: clicking a collapsed row such as '{ ...4 keys }' only selects it and opens the Node panel; it does not expand, so the maker must find the tiny triangle (about 8 px). A click on the row text of a collapsed node should expand it, and double click should too

With the Node panel open the view toolbar loses Edit and Copy at 1440 px wide (three panels: left 300, Node 320, drawer) and Wrap sits against the panel edge; the Tree gets about 760 px; the Node panel needs to be a overlay or the toolbar needs an overflow menu

Node panel 'Copy Path' copies '[0]' (a bare JS style path) while the Power Platform expressions use body('Parse_JSON')?['value']; the panel should offer 'Copy path', 'Copy as Power Automate' and 'Copy as Power Fx' buttons so makers do not have to open the drawer
Wrap toggle shows as pressed but nothing changes on short lines and there is no indication of what it wraps (tree values, long strings); the toggle also persists no state across tabs

LIKELY ROOT CAUSE of the SQL failures (Find blank, Distinct Values, Column Stats, Fuzzy): after several tabs are opened, closed and reopened, the engine looks for table tab_5 but only tab_3 exists ('Catalog Error: Table with name tab_5 does not exist! Did you mean tab_3?' in the console during Find and Replace All); engine tab tables are registered once and never re-registered or renamed when tabs change. Fix the table registry first, then retest all four features

Ctrl+H opens Find and Replace with the cursor in the Replace box instead of the Find box, so typing goes to the wrong field. Replace All works ('Replaced 1 occurrence(s)') and the data changes, but Ctrl+Z only toasts 'Undo' and the value stays 'anna@' (undo does not revert a replace), and Replace gives no preview of what will change

CRITICAL, wrong document analysed: on the tab 'Pasted JSON' the Table shows the 2 email rows, but the Analyze drawer (6 nodes, 3 keys, 1 str 2 num 1 bool) and the Overview ('An object with 3 top-level keys, 37 B, tags 2 items') describe a different document, the edited sample-data.json tab; opening Overview or the Field Profiler button on this tab shows that other file's summary. Happened after opening, closing (Alt+W), reopening from Recent and switching tabs; same family as the tab_5 / tab_3 table mismatch, so fix the per tab analysis cache and engine ids together and add a smoke test that opens three files, switches and closes tabs, and checks the Overview of each

Charts dialog (Chart This Column) works with a stats row and histogram, but the label 'tallest bar:' is printed on top of the right bar and cut off, the 'In file order' line chart has no axis, labels or values, and 'Array $ (2)' is a cryptic name for the list being charted (should read 'Rows of the whole file (2)')

Re-checked after +All and D2: the tree controls work, but the Analyze drawer still shows the wrong document's numbers (6 nodes) while the Tree shows the 2 email rows, so the stale analysis persists until the tab is reloaded; the Explorer rail button again opens a new empty tab ('Untitled 7' after 'Untitled 5', so the counter also skips numbers) and the rail shows both Explorer-style and Query buttons as active

principles: Fresh rewrite: reuse V1 logic, but no backward-compatibility layers (no window.App shims). Everything lives under window.Structra.
V2 should end up better and different from V1, not a copy.
followUps: Session restore works (tabs, view, path, stored original). It only saves the stored copy once the page is idle, so a reload within a few seconds of opening a file restores an empty tab.
Fixture smoke test (30 small V1 fixtures, all six views each) passed with zero page errors after the redesign. It is run by hand through Playwright; task 10.8 turns it into a committed script.
Task 12 smoke run: 30 of 30 fixtures opened in all six views with zero page errors, and TypeScript generation checked on jsonobject.json.
Top-level null, false, 0 and empty string documents cannot be opened (jsonData doubles as the has-data flag). The app shows a clear message instead.
Large files (above 120 MB) open on the tree, and there is no cancel button. Parsing stays on the main thread because copying data to a worker cost more than parsing it.

Fixed after the light-mode pass: the side-by-side diff never highlighted changed lines (line numbers were never set); it now marks changed, removed and added lines by data path. The font-size token now matches the 14 px the app actually runs at.
